text:
Developing a mobile app involves more than just writing code. A critical first step is choosing between native and cross-platform development. Native apps are built for a specific system, like iOS or Android, offering top performance and a smooth user experience, but they require separate codebases. Cross-platform tools, however, let you write one codebase for both, saving time and money, though performance can sometimes suffer.

Regardless of the approach, responsive design is essential. Your app must display beautifully on different screen sizes and handle various orientations. Finally, performance is key; users expect fast loading and instant responses. Once your app is polished, you'll need to publish it through official app stores, following their strict guidelines for review and approval.
